audit_pre.evidence: No paper found linking stock returns to tramway/light-rail construction; hits concerned housing prices or unrelated stock topics.

audit_post.evidence: No paper found; light-rail anticipation studies concern housing prices, not stock returns.

audit_pre.title: Gentrification Trends in New Transit-Oriented Communities: Evidence from 14 Cities That Expanded and Built Rail Transit Systems
audit_pre.evidence: Title: studies gentrification in neighborhoods around new rail transit stations across 14 cities.

audit_post.title: Transit-Induced Gentrification or Vice Versa? A Study of Neighborhoods Around Light Rail Stations From 1970-2010
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: examines gentrification in all LRT station areas before and after station opening vs control areas; finds signs of gentrification near new stations.

audit_pre.evidence: Partisan politics and stock returns papers found (e.g., W2963154642, presidential puzzle), but none study momentum strategies.

audit_post.evidence: Partisanship-investor belief and partisan return comovement papers found (W3034114748, W4416729021 is 2025), none on momentum strategies.

audit_pre.evidence: Only papers on financing TOD/transit via value capture (not research funding); no paper links research funding to TOD.

audit_post.evidence: Same; TOD finance/value capture literature only, not research funding.

audit_pre.evidence: Pre-2020 Treynor-ratio papers (e.g., W1819619164 portfolio construction using Treynor's ratio; W2971818358) evaluate stock performance but do not explicitly link to expected stock returns in title/abstract.

audit_post.title: Analysis of returns and risk of securities under the CAPM: Sharpe ratio and Treynor ratio (Thai)
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: applies CAPM and Treynor/Sharpe ratios to Thai stocks, comparing expected returns with risk to classify stocks as under/overvalued. Weak-moderate match.

audit_pre.title: Improving Pathways to Fixed-Route Transit: Transit Agency Practices to Expand Access for All Users
audit_pre.evidence: Title: transit agency practices to expand access to fixed-route transit.

audit_post.title: Planning for the First and Last Mile: A Review of Practices at Selected Transit Agencies in the United States
audit_post.evidence: Title: reviews transit agency practices for first/last-mile access to transit.

audit_pre.title: A simple method to assess walkability around metro stations
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: method to assess walking/biking access to metro stations, applied to three proposed metro station catchments in Doha, Qatar.

audit_post.title: Analysis of Built Environment Factors on Walkability at Three Doha Metro Stations
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: examines pedestrian sheds, connectivity and walkability (access) at three Doha Metro stations.

audit_pre.title: Stock returns and volatility: An empirical study of the UK stock market
audit_pre.evidence: Title: empirical study of stock returns in the UK stock market.

audit_post.title: Interaction between investor sentiment, limits to arbitrage and the returns of stock market anomalies: evidence from the UK stock market
audit_post.evidence: Title: studies returns of stock market anomalies in the UK stock market.

audit_pre.title: Is Just Growth Smarter Growth? The Effects of Gentrification on Transit Ridership and Driving in Los Angeles' Transit Station Area Neighborhoods
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: transit improvements bring wealthier car-owning residents; analyzes gentrification effects on transit ridership (displacement of lower-income transit riders implied). Moderate match.

audit_post.title: Creating inequality in access to public transit? Densification, gentrification, and displacement
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: densification/gentrification around train stations reduces share of low-income residents and raises displacement risk, framed as inequality in access to public transit. Close variant (low-income residents/potential riders), weak-moderate match.

audit_pre.title: Asset Fire Sales (and Purchases) in Equity Markets
audit_pre.evidence: Mutual fund extreme flows force trading that creates price pressure in held stocks, followed by subsequent price reversal.

audit_post.title: Measuring Mutual Fund Flow Pressure as Shock to Stock Returns
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: re-examines outflow-induced price pressure; corrected measure shows negligible decline with no subsequent reversal.

audit_pre.title: Towards inclusive and sustainable transformation in Shenzhen: Urban redevelopment, displacement patterns of migrants and policy implications
audit_pre.evidence: Title links displacement patterns from urban redevelopment to inclusive transformation/policy (planning) implications.

audit_post.title: From Inclusive Legacy Promises to Exclusive Realities: Planning, Design, and Displacement in Post-Olympic East London
audit_post.evidence: Title explicitly examines how inclusive planning promises relate to displacement outcomes. Alternative: W3002967725 (2020) on neighbourhood planning to minimise displacement for inclusivity.

audit_pre.title: Comparing Transit-Oriented Development Sites by Walkability Indicators
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: pedestrian access/walkability is a key component of TOD; compares TOD sites using walkability indicators.

audit_post.title: Identifying walkability factors for urban metro station areas toward transit-oriented development
audit_post.evidence: Abstract delineates walkability factors of metro station areas to support TOD.

audit_pre.title: HISTOSPLINE INTERPOLATION FOR DATA INPUT INTO THE TRANSIT RIDERSHIP FORECASTING MODEL
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract describes preparing trip generation input data for the Transit Ridership Forecasting Model (method linking trip generation to ridership estimation).

audit_post.evidence: Ridership forecasting papers found (e.g. W3011518889 direct ridership models, Wuhan) do not explicitly address trip generation.

items.item_id: adaptive market hypothesis || stock market efficiency

audit_pre.title: Stock market anomalies, market efficiency and the adaptive market hypothesis: Evidence from Islamic stock indices
audit_pre.evidence: Title explicitly tests stock market efficiency under the adaptive market hypothesis. Alternative: W2069950800 (2014, Tehran).

audit_post.title: The adaptive markets hypothesis: Insights into small stock market efficiency
audit_post.evidence: Abstract tests whether AMH describes Finnish stock market efficiency better than EMH.

audit_pre.title: Modeling gentrification dynamics: A hybrid approach
audit_pre.evidence: Title: simulation modeling of gentrification dynamics (close variant of scenario modeling); no abstract in OpenAlex.

audit_post.title: Agent-based simulation of short-term peer-to-peer rentals: Evidence from the Amsterdam housing market
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: agent-based simulation of gentrification/rent gap in Amsterdam, comparing regulation (policy) scenarios and their effects.

audit_pre.title: Is there a risk-return trade-off? Evidence from high-frequency data
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: uses daily realized (and GARCH, implied, range) volatility to test the intertemporal risk-return trade-off.

audit_post.title: Risk-return trade-off in the Australian Securities Exchange: Accounting for overnight effects, realized higher moments, long-run relations, and fractional cointegration
audit_post.evidence: Title: risk-return trade-off estimated with realized moments (realized volatility measures); no abstract in OpenAlex.

audit_pre.title: Tweets and peers: defining industry groups and strategic peers based on investor perceptions of stocks on Twitter
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: tests whether co-association of company pairs on Twitter stock forum relates to comovement of their stocks. Also W2017186882 (2015) social-media-based prediction of stock comovement.

audit_post.title: Twitter-Based Economic Uncertainty and US Energy Market: An Investigation Using Wavelet Coherence
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: co-movement between Twitter-based economic uncertainty index and US energy stocks / S&P 500.

audit_pre.title: Economic Links and Predictable Returns
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: return predictability across economically linked firms; long-short strategy yields abnormal returns (alphas >150bp/month).

audit_post.title: Stock return predictability of the cumulative abnormal returns around the earnings announcement date: Evidence from China
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: cumulative abnormal returns around earnings announcements significantly predict subsequent stock returns.

audit_pre.title: Investigating the Customer Satisfaction of the Bus Service in Qatar
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: Doha's challenge of attracting more users to its bus service; studies service quality as driver of ridership. Weak match (ridership is motivation rather than measured outcome).

audit_post.title: Analysis of mode choice affects from the introduction of Doha Metro using machine learning and statistical analysis
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: influence of new Doha Metro on travel mode choice (metro uptake) in Doha. Also W4316672613 (2023, Qatar University) predicts metro ridership from land use, but abstract does not name Doha.

audit_pre.evidence: No paper explicitly linking expected stock returns to New Orleans; hits only mention New Orleans as a conference venue; Katrina/oil-stock event studies (e.g. W280045837) do not name New Orleans in relation to returns.

audit_post.evidence: No matching paper found; hurricane-stock return studies do not explicitly concern New Orleans.

audit_pre.evidence: No paper found whose title/abstract explicitly links the two concepts.

audit_post.evidence: No paper found whose title/abstract explicitly links the two concepts.

audit_pre.title: Abnormal returns: econometric problems or psychological bias?
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract tests whether event-study abnormal returns are due to econometric problems or to psychological bias generated by irrational investors.

audit_post.title: Investor Irrational Behaviour and Abnormal Stock Returns: A Case of Nairobi Securities Exchange
audit_post.evidence: Title/abstract: effect of investor irrational behaviour (herding, loss aversion, mental accounting, overconfidence) on abnormal stock returns.

audit_pre.title: A design framework for measuring transit oriented development
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract reviews the different methods and indicator sets proposed to evaluate and measure TOD and proposes a methodological design framework.

audit_post.title: Developing a Transit-Oriented Development Research Methodology for the Cities of Najaf and Kufa, Republic of Iraq
audit_post.evidence: Title explicitly develops a TOD research methodology (expert-weighted indicators, spatial multi-criteria GIS TOD index).

audit_pre.evidence: No paper found whose title/abstract explicitly links the two concepts.

audit_post.evidence: No paper found whose title/abstract explicitly links the two concepts.

audit_pre.title: A closer look at return predictability of the US stock market: evidence from new panel variance ratio tests
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: examines return predictability of the US stock market with panel variance ratio tests; returns predictable 1964-1996, unpredictable after 1997.

audit_post.title: Stock Return Predictability: Evidence Across US Industries
audit_post.evidence: Title explicitly studies stock return predictability across US industries (US stock market).

audit_pre.title: Light Rail and the American City: State-of-the-Practice for Transit-Oriented Development
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: FTA elevated land use (transit-oriented, mixed-use development) as a consideration in New Starts funding recommendations; links TOD land use to New Starts ratings. Close-variant match (TOD/land use rather than 'mixed-use' verbatim).

audit_post.evidence: No paper found whose title/abstract explicitly links the two concepts.

audit_pre.title: Financial stress in emerging markets: Patterns, real effects, and cross-country spillovers
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: hierarchical cluster analysis groups 14 emerging economies by financial stress structure, combined with analysis of cross-country spillovers.

audit_post.title: Fuzzy clustering of financial time series based on volatility spillovers
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: clustering of stocks based on directional volatility spillovers (fuzzy rather than hierarchical clustering; close variant).

audit_pre.title: Event study methodologies and the size effect
audit_pre.evidence: Title: studies how event study methodology interacts with the firm size (market capitalization) effect.

audit_post.title: Impact of Covid-19 on Stock Market Capitalization: A Study on the Pakistan Stock Exchange
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: uses event study method to analyze changes in market capitalization before, during and after COVID-19.

audit_pre.title: Price Momentum and Idiosyncratic Volatility
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: momentum returns higher among high idiosyncratic volatility stocks; IVol limits arbitrage of momentum.

audit_post.title: Are momentum profits influenced by idiosyncratic volatility? Evidence from India
audit_post.evidence: Abstract: examines relationship between momentum returns and idiosyncratic volatility; IV significantly affects momentum strategies.

audit_pre.title: Market efficiency in emerging stock markets: A case study of the Vietnamese stock market
audit_pre.evidence: Abstract: tests weak-form efficiency of Vietnamese stock market using autocorrelation, variance ratio and runs tests.

audit_post.title: Testing Market Efficiency in Emerging Markets' Stock Indices with Runs Tests
audit_post.evidence: Title/abstract: tests efficient market hypothesis in seven emerging stock indices with runs tests.
